Canada and Alberta Launch New West Coast Oil Pipeline Project

The governments of Canada and Alberta have announced plans for a new west coast oil pipeline aimed at boosting exports. The project includes a C$150 billion pledge intended to address concerns from British Columbia and First Nations communities. Measures such as port expansion and whale protections are part of the initiative.
